Updating a device: firmware running these builds checks this page's update.json feed from its web UI. Devices on firmware older than 2.13 are first routed to the upstream 2.13.3 stepping-stone release.

Stable links: latest/shelly-homekit-<Model>.zip always points at the newest build.

A fork of the shelly-homekit project (Apache-2.0). Not affiliated with Allterco Robotics / Shelly.
